name: Kurimiya Mikan
source:
Key Emotion: Regret
Rank: B-rank

[url=/c13061]Yuuji's[/url] upperclassman who looks younger due to her short stature and who is a carrier, carrying Orihime's spirit inside her. She is very good at cooking and other household chores, and also mature, but naturally shy around other people. Her trigger emotion is "regret", which came from the regret of quitting playing the flute when she was younger, and which is also related to her grandfather. When she starts regretting something, she starts crying out lots of milk.
